purpose: Five-seed tau sensitivity at frozen selected coefficients

reporting.native_threshold: risk metrics computed using each run's own tau
reporting.fixed_anchor: risk metrics computed on the same recommendations using tau_eval=0.1
reporting.reason: separates recommendation changes from the mechanical effect of redefining a violation
reporting.statistics: mean and sample SD across five seeds; paired post-hoc-minus-integrated mean difference and two-sided 95% paired-t CI
reporting.selection_prohibition: tau sensitivity is analysis-only and cannot revise lambda_d, gamma, or select a preferred tau
